name: Chang Chen-yue
profileSummary: Ayal Komod, better known by his stage name A-Yue or Chang Chen-yue, is an aboriginal Taiwanese rock and Hip-Hop musician, singer-songwriter and guitarist, and the frontman of his band, Free Night, also known as Free9. He is most widely known for his 1998 hit song "Ai Wo Bie Zou". His 2013 album I am Ayal Komod won Best Mandarin Album at the 25th Golden Melody Awards. His 2025 album Go With The Flow won him Best Mandarin Male Singer, Best Mandarin Album and Best Composer at the 37th Golden Melody Awards.
